title: [Capital gain on transfer of jewellery held for personal use not to be charged in certain cases.]
text:
54C. [Capital gain on transfer of jewellery held for personal use not to be charged in certain cases.]—

_Omitted by the Finance Act, 1976_ (66 of 1976) (w.e.f. 1-4-1976). Earlier inserted by Act 16 of 1972, s. 9
(w.e.f. 1-4-1973).
